```{r data-loading}
samdat <- read_tsv("sample.metadata.tsv")
colnames(samdat) <- c("SampleID", "sample_label", "raw_seq_file", "group")

# Process sample_label to extract additional information
samdat <- samdat %>%
  separate(sample_label, into = c("subjectID", "replicate_code", "timepoint"), sep = "\\.", remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract carbohydrate type from replicate_code
    carbohydrate = case_when(
      str_detect(replicate_code, "R") ~ "rapid",
      str_detect(replicate_code, "S") ~ "slow",
      TRUE ~ "no_carbohydrate"
    ),
    # Extract replicate number from replicate_code
    replicate = str_extract(replicate_code, "\\d+") %>% as.numeric(),
    # Replace NA values in replicate with 1
    replicate = ifelse(is.na(replicate), 1, replicate)
  ) %>%
  select(-replicate_code, -group)  # Remove the intermediate replicate_code column

# Display the processed metadata
print(samdat)

# now get the group information for health and obese

group <- read_tsv("zr24558.16S_250813.zymo/1.Healthy.TimepointComparism..Bac16Sv34/Sample_Information/sample.metadata.csv")

# Extract subjectID from customer_label
group <- group %>%
  separate(customer_label, into = c("subjectID", "replicate_code", "timepoint"), sep = "\\.", remove = FALSE) %>%
  select(customer_label, subjectID, everything())

# now where group$subjectID is in samdat$subjectID, the samdat$group should be "Healthy" and otherwise be "Obese"
samdat <- samdat %>%
  mutate(
    group = ifelse(subjectID %in% group$subjectID, "Healthy", "Obese")
  )

# now output a summary of the metadata in samdat
# summarize samdat by group and carbohydrate
samdat_summary <- samdat %>%
  group_by(group, carbohydrate) %>%
  summarize(n_samples = n())

samdat_summary

# number of unique subjects per group
samdat %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarize(n_subjects = n_distinct(subjectID))


write_csv(samdat, file = "samdat.csv")
```

```{r dada2-pipeline}
library(dada2)

fastqFs <- list.files("fastq_files", pattern = "R1.fastq.gz", full.names = TRUE) %>% sort()
fastqRs <- list.files("fastq_files", pattern = "R2.fastq.gz", full.names = TRUE) %>% sort()

# get the sample names from the fastq files
sample_names <- sapply(strsplit(basename(fastqFs), "_"), function(x) paste0(x[1],"_", x[2]))

# filter the fastq files
filtered_fastq_dir <- "filtered_fastq"
if (!dir.exists(filtered_fastq_dir)) {
  dir.create(filtered_fastq_dir)
}

if(!file.exists("filtered_fastq_out.RData")) {
    # filter the fastq files
    filtFs <- file.path(filtered_fastq_dir, paste0(sample_names, "_F_filt.fastq.gz")) %>% sort()
    filtRs <- file.path(filtered_fastq_dir, paste0(sample_names, "_R_filt.fastq.gz")) %>% sort()

    # filter the fastq files
    out <- filterAndTrim(fastqFs, filtFs, fastqRs, filtRs, truncLen=c(240,240), maxN=0, maxEE=c(2,2), truncQ=2, rm.phix=TRUE, compress=TRUE, multithread=TRUE, verbose=TRUE)

    save(sample_names, filtFs, filtRs, out, file = "filtered_fastq_out.RData")
}

if(!file.exists("dada2_out.RData")) {
    # now load the filtered fastq files
    load("filtered_fastq_out.RData")

    # now learn the error rates
    cat("Learning error rates...\n")
    errF <- learnErrors(filtFs, multithread=TRUE)
    errR <- learnErrors(filtRs, multithread=TRUE)

    cat("Running DADA2...\n")
    dadaFs <- dada(filtFs, err=errF, multithread=TRUE)
    dadaRs <- dada(filtRs, err=errR, multithread=TRUE)

    save(errF, errR, dadaFs, dadaRs, file = "dada2_out.RData")
}

if(!file.exists("seqtab.nochim.RData")) {
    load("filtered_fastq_out.RData")
    load("dada2_out.RData")

    # now merge the forward and reverse reads
    cat("Merging forward and reverse reads...\n")
    mergers <- mergePairs(dadaFs, filtFs, dadaRs, filtRs, verbose=TRUE)

    # now construct the sequence table
    cat("Constructing sequence table...\n")
    seqtab <- makeSequenceTable(mergers)

    repseqs <- Biostrings::DNAStringSet(getSequences(seqtab))
    names(repseqs) <- paste0("ASV", seq(length(repseqs)))
    Biostrings::writeXStringSet(repseqs, file = "repseqs.chimeras.fasta")

    save(mergers, seqtab, file = "seqtab.RData")

    # now remove chimeras
    # using vsearch uchim3 approach for speed and sensitivity balance
    system("vsearch --uchime_ref repseqs.chimeras.fasta --db references/SILVA_138.1_SSURef_Nr99_tax_silva.fasta --nonchimeras repseqs.nochimera.fasta --threads 18")

    nonchimeric_seqs <- Biostrings::readDNAStringSet("repseqs.nochimera.fasta")

    w <- which(getSequences(seqtab) %in% getSequences(nonchimeric_seqs))
    
    seqtab.nochim <- seqtab[, w]

    repseqs <- Biostrings::DNAStringSet(getSequences(seqtab.nochim))
    names(repseqs) <- paste0("ASV", seq(length(repseqs)))

    Biostrings::writeXStringSet(repseqs, file = "repseqs.nochimera.fasta")

    save(mergers, seqtab, seqtab.nochim,  nonchimeric_seqs, repseqs, file = "seqtab.nochim.RData")
}

# assign taxonomy
library(DECIPHER)

cat("Assigning taxonomy...\n")
load("./references/SILVA_SSU_r138_2_2024.RData")
dna <- Biostrings::DNAStringSet(getSequences(seqtab.nochim))
ids <- IdTaxa(dna, trainingSet, strand = "top", processors = 18, verbose = TRUE)
ranks <- c("Domain", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")

# Convert DECIPHER Taxa object to data.frame with taxonomic hierarchy
# Function to extract data from individual Taxa entries
extract_taxa_info <- function(taxa_entry) {
  # Each entry is a list with taxon, confidence, and rank components
  taxon_vector <- taxa_entry$taxon
  confidence_vector <- taxa_entry$confidence
  rank_vector <- taxa_entry$rank

  # Initialize result with all levels as "unclassified"
  result <- c(
    Domain = "unclassified",
    Phylum = "unclassified",
    Class = "unclassified",
    Order = "unclassified",
    Family = "unclassified",
    Genus = "unclassified",
    Species = "unclassified"
  )

  # Map ranks to standard taxonomic levels
  rank_mapping <- c(
    "domain" = "Domain",
    "phylum" = "Phylum",
    "class" = "Class",
    "order" = "Order",
    "family" = "Family",
    "genus" = "Genus",
    "species" = "Species"
  )

  # Fill in taxonomic information based on ranks
  for (i in seq_along(rank_vector)) {
    rank <- rank_vector[i]
    taxon <- taxon_vector[i]

    # Skip "Root" and "rootrank"
    if (rank == "rootrank" || taxon == "Root") {
      next
    }

    # Map rank to standard level
    if (rank %in% names(rank_mapping)) {
      level <- rank_mapping[rank]

      # Clean up taxonomy names
      if (grepl("^unclassified_", taxon)) {
        result[level] <- "unclassified"
      } else {
        result[level] <- taxon
      }
    }
  }

  # Get the minimum confidence (most conservative estimate)
  # Skip confidence for "Root" level
  non_root_indices <- rank_vector != "rootrank"
  if (any(non_root_indices)) {
    min_confidence <- min(confidence_vector[non_root_indices]) / 100
  } else {
    min_confidence <- NA
  }

  return(c(result, Confidence = min_confidence))
}

# Apply extraction to all entries in the Taxa object
cat("Extracting taxonomic information from", length(ids), "entries...\n")

# Process all entries
all_results <- lapply(ids, extract_taxa_info)

# Convert to matrix then data.frame
results_matrix <- do.call(rbind, all_results)

# Create the final data.frame with proper column types
taxonomy_df <- data.frame(
  Domain = as.character(results_matrix[, "Domain"]),
  Phylum = as.character(results_matrix[, "Phylum"]),
  Class = as.character(results_matrix[, "Class"]),
  Order = as.character(results_matrix[, "Order"]),
  Family = as.character(results_matrix[, "Family"]),
  Genus = as.character(results_matrix[, "Genus"]),
  Species = as.character(results_matrix[, "Species"]),
  Confidence = as.numeric(results_matrix[, "Confidence"]),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Display results
cat("Conversion complete!\n")
cat("Data.frame dimensions:", dim(taxonomy_df), "\n")

# Show first few rows
cat("\nFirst few rows:\n")
print(head(taxonomy_df))

# Show structure
cat("\nStructure:\n")
str(taxonomy_df)

# Summary of confidence values
cat("\nConfidence summary:\n")
summary(taxonomy_df$Confidence)

# Count of assignments at each taxonomic level
cat("\nTaxonomic assignment counts (non-unclassified):\n")
for (col in c("Domain", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")) {
  assigned_count <- sum(taxonomy_df[[col]] != "unclassified")
  cat(sprintf("%s: %d (%.1f%%)\n", col, assigned_count, 100 * assigned_count / nrow(taxonomy_df)))
}

save(dna, ids, taxonomy_df, file = "taxid.RData")

asv_names <- paste0("ASV", seq(ncol(seqtab.nochim)))
names(dna) <- asv_names
colnames(seqtab.nochim) <- asv_names
rownames(taxonomy_df) <- asv_names

save(seqtab.nochim, dna, taxonomy_df, file = "seqtab.nochim.RData")
```

```{r readin-asv-finder-sintax-taxonomy}
taxtab_sintax <- read_tsv("taxonomy-abbott.tsv")
```

```{r make-phyloseq-objects}
library(phyloseq)

# need to prep the seqtab.nochim rownames to match the format of samdat
rownames(seqtab.nochim) <- sapply(strsplit(rownames(seqtab.nochim), "_"), function(x) paste(x[1:2], collapse = "_"))
taxmatrix <- as.matrix(taxonomy_df)
samdat <- as.data.frame(samdat)
rownames(samdat) <- samdat$SampleID

phy_decipher <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(seqtab.nochim, taxa_are_rows = FALSE),
  tax_table(taxmatrix),
  sample_data(samdat),
  refseq(dna)
)

taxmatrix <- as.matrix(taxtab_sintax)
rownames(taxmatrix) <- rownames(seqtab.nochim)

phy_sintax <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(seqtab.nochim, taxa_are_rows = FALSE),
  tax_table(taxtab_sintax),
  sample_data(samdat),
  refseq(dna)
)

save(phy_decipher, phy_sintax, file = "phyloseq_objects.RData")
```
